name: G.K. Consultants Limited
summary: G.K. Consultants Ltd. is a firm dedicated to offering non-banking financial services. Its business operations are diverse, covering areas such as equity trading, management of derivatives and options, provision of professional assistance, marketing efforts, generation of interest income, delivery of information technology services, and various investment undertakings. Established on December 2, 1988, the company's primary office is located in New Delhi, India.
